description:
`/work/files.txt` lists files, one path per line; ignore blank lines and whitespace around a path. For each listed path, run the checksum tool `/work/bin/slowsum PATH`, passing the path exactly as listed. On success the tool prints the file's SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex digits and a newline on standard output and exits with status 0. When it cannot read the file it prints a message on standard error and exits with a nonzero status.

Each run of the tool takes a fraction of a second, so run it for several files at the same time, but never more than 3 runs at once. Run it exactly once per listed path.

Print one JSON object per line to standard output, one per listed path, in list order: `{"file": PATH, "sha256": HEX}` on success, or `{"file": PATH, "error": MESSAGE}`, where `MESSAGE` is the first line of the tool's standard error with surrounding whitespace removed. Exit with status 0 when every run succeeded and with status 4 otherwise.
